bio: Annie Elizabeth Andrews (née Lintzenich; born August 9, 1980) is an American pediatrician and politician who is a United States senator-elect from South Carolina. A member of the Democratic Party, Andrews is the first woman elected to the Senate from South Carolina and the first Democrat to win a Senate election in South Carolina since 1998.
